name: @pipeworx/mcp-israel-tenders

tools.name: israel_search_tenders
tools.description: Search Israeli government competitive tenders (מכרזים) from the official Government Procurement Administration dataset on data.gov.il. Returns each tender's publication number, name, publishing ministry and unit, procedure type, status, publication/closing dates, winning supplier, and subject area. Pass a free-text query (Hebrew or matching text) to filter, e.g. "בריאות" (health) or a ministry name; omit to browse the most recent records.

query.description: Free-text search across all fields (Hebrew works best), e.g. a ministry, subject, or supplier name. Omit to browse.

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination (default 0).

tools.name: israel_search_exemptions
tools.description: Search Israeli government exemption contracts and non-competitive procurement (התקשרויות בפטור והליכים תחרותיים) from the official Government Procurement Administration dataset on data.gov.il. Returns each contract's publication number, name, publishing ministry and unit, exemption regulation (תקנה), status, decision essence, approver, dates, supplier, monetary amount, currency, and subject. Pass a free-text query (Hebrew or matching text) to filter; omit to browse the most recent records.

query.description: Free-text search across all fields (Hebrew works best), e.g. a ministry, supplier, or subject. Omit to browse.

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination (default 0).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-israel-tenders forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the israel-tenders pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
